name: plain projection
sql: SELECT o.id FROM ORDERS o

name: two aliases
sql: SELECT a.id AS first_id,b.id AS other_id FROM ORDERS a LEFT JOIN ORDERS b ON a.customer_id=b.customer_id

name: nested CTEs
sql: WITH a AS (SELECT id FROM ORDERS), b AS (SELECT id FROM a) SELECT id FROM b

name: explicit CTE columns
sql: WITH a(order_key) AS (SELECT id FROM ORDERS) SELECT order_key FROM a

name: FROM subquery
sql: SELECT s.id FROM (SELECT id FROM ORDERS) s

name: qualified wildcard
sql: SELECT o.* FROM ORDERS o

name: USING
sql: SELECT o.id FROM ORDERS o JOIN CUSTOMERS c USING (id)

name: cross join
sql: SELECT o.id AS order_id,c.id AS customer_id FROM ORDERS o CROSS JOIN CUSTOMERS c

name: right outer join
sql: SELECT o.id FROM ORDERS o RIGHT OUTER JOIN CUSTOMERS c ON o.customer_id=c.id

name: full outer join
sql: SELECT o.id FROM ORDERS o FULL OUTER JOIN CUSTOMERS c ON o.customer_id=c.id

name: non-equality dependency
sql: SELECT o.id FROM ORDERS o LEFT JOIN PAYMENTS p ON p.amount > o.id

name: compound OR
sql: SELECT o.id FROM ORDERS o LEFT JOIN PAYMENTS p ON p.order_id=o.id OR p.id=o.id

name: CASE with literal punctuation
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN o.status='JOIN x,(' THEN 'a.b' ELSE 'other' END AS label FROM ORDERS o

name: grouping and ordering
sql: SELECT customer_id,SUM(id) AS total FROM ORDERS GROUP BY customer_id HAVING SUM(id)>0 ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 10

name: window preserves rows
sql: SELECT id,SUM(id) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total FROM ORDERS

name: count star
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM ORDERS

name: quoted aliases
sql: SELECT "o"."id" FROM "ORDERS" AS "o"

name: fixed pivot
sql: SELECT p.customer_id,p.Q1 FROM SALES PIVOT (SUM(revenue) FOR quarter IN ([Q1],[Q2])) p

name: unknown alias
sql: SELECT x.id FROM ORDERS o

name: unknown column
sql: SELECT o.no_such_column FROM ORDERS o

name: ambiguous column
sql: SELECT id FROM ORDERS o JOIN CUSTOMERS c ON o.customer_id=c.id

name: forward ON reference
sql: SELECT o.id FROM ORDERS o JOIN PAYMENTS p ON p.id=rf.payment_id JOIN REFUNDS rf ON rf.payment_id=p.id

name: duplicate alias
sql: SELECT o.id FROM ORDERS o JOIN PAYMENTS o ON o.id=o.id

name: missing ON
sql: SELECT o.id FROM ORDERS o LEFT JOIN PAYMENTS p

name: incomplete parentheses
sql: SELECT COALESCE(o.id,0 AS value FROM ORDERS o

name: union unsupported
sql: SELECT id FROM ORDERS UNION SELECT id FROM CUSTOMERS

name: recursive CTE unsupported
sql: WITH RECURSIVE x AS (SELECT id FROM ORDERS) SELECT id FROM x

name: scalar subquery unsupported
sql: SELECT (SELECT id FROM CUSTOMERS) AS x FROM ORDERS

name: unknown CTE column
sql: WITH x AS (SELECT id FROM ORDERS) SELECT x.customer_id FROM x

name: duplicate output
sql: SELECT id,id FROM ORDERS

name: formula needs alias
sql: SELECT id+1 FROM ORDERS

name: multiple statements
sql: SELECT id FROM ORDERS; SELECT id FROM CUSTOMERS

name: CTE column mismatch
sql: WITH a(x,y) AS (SELECT id FROM ORDERS) SELECT x FROM a

name: dynamic pivot unsupported
sql: SELECT p.customer_id FROM SALES PIVOT (SUM(revenue) FOR quarter IN (SELECT quarter FROM SALES)) p
